main.description: Replace a space's policy wholesale. If the policy $type is unchanged this is a configuration change; if it differs the space migrates to the new policy and state from the previous policy is discarded. The authenticated user must be the space authority. Requires auth, implemented by PDS.

space.description: Reference to the space to update.

errors.name: UnsupportedPolicy
errors.description: A requested policy is not one the host implements.
